svg.title: Eight port complexes take 63% of large-ship port visits, led by the lower Mississippi (16%) and Houston-Galveston (13%)

cc:Work.dc:title: Eight port complexes take 63% of large-ship port visits, led by the lower Mississippi (16%) and Houston-Galveston (13%)
cc:Work.dc:description: Waffle chart of 100 squares, each 1% of large-ship port visits, colored by port complex; the lower Mississippi and Houston-Galveston fill 29 squares, and all other ports fill about a third.
